note: 5 web searches; summaries are own wording; no commercial ratings/reviews copied; secondary sources, verify before showing to users

items.name: Stadion Letzigrund
items.summary: Shared home ground of FC Zürich, Grasshopper Club Zürich and the athletics club LC Zürich; the current stadium opened in 2007 and the sources give capacities between about 26,000 and 31,000.

items.name: Swiss Life Arena
items.summary: Ice-hockey arena of the ZSC Lions in Altstetten (Vulkanstrasse 130), opened October 2022, about 12,000 seats, a few minutes on foot from Altstetten station.

items.name: Flussbad Oberer Letten
items.summary: Free river bathing site on the Limmat with a concrete platform and a roughly 400 m swimming channel; season is roughly mid-May to mid-September, swimming at own risk.

items.name: Flussbad Unterer Letten
items.summary: Oldest river bath of the city (early 1900s), renovated in stages since 2023; one listing describes restricted access rules, so check before going.

items.name: Seebad Utoquai
items.summary: Lake bath on the promenade between Bellevue and Zürichhorn with an entry fee and one of the longer seasons among the lake baths (about mid-April to end of October according to one guide).

items.name: Zurich Christmas markets 2026
items.summary: The Wienachtsdorf at Sechseläutenplatz ends; from 2026 a new operator runs a replacement market called Bellevue Noël, reported for 19 Nov to 23 Dec 2026 (dates from low-quality travel sites, verify).

items.name: Street Parade
items.summary: Large techno parade held every August on the lake basin, running from Thursday evening to early Monday morning; the 2026 date was not confirmed by the search.

items.name: Sechseläuten
items.summary: Spring festival held in April with a guild procession on Sechseläutenplatz; no 2026 date was confirmed by the search.

items.name: Tenz
items.summary: Street-food outlet reported to have taken its first permanent premises near Langstrasse; undated article, verify.

items.name: Baur's (Baur au Lac)
items.summary: New brasserie and bar at the Baur au Lac hotel in Kreis 1, described as a new hot spot; undated.
